title: Using AI Agents to Automate Black-Box Audits of Personalization Algorithms at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Stratifying synthetic LLM agent personas by a priori political ideology (left-leaning vs. right-leaning) and comparing the amplification of right-leaning, left-leaning, toxic, and polarizing content in their algorithmically curated feeds relative to chronological feeds.
Applying counterfactual perturbations to the declared birth date of synthetic accounts during registration and measuring the causal effect on the algorithmic amplification of different content types.
Applying counterfactual perturbations to account display names to signal different genders and measuring the resulting changes in algorithmic content delivery.

Applying counterfactual perturbations to account IP addresses using state-level residential proxies to signal different locations (rural vs. urban) and evaluating the causal impact on the recommendation algorithm's behavior.
